newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Mycogen FY98 EPS cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Mycogen FY98 EPS cut.

text.p: Dain Bosworth analyst Bonnie Wittenburg said Thursday she lowered her fiscal 1998 earnings estimate for Mycogen Corp to a loss of $0.05 a share from a profit of $0.25 due to expected legal costs to defend its patents.
-- She reiterated her buy rating on the agricultural biotechnology firm.

-- "We believe that Mycogen's seasonally important third-quarter 1997 results, which we expect Mycogen to release July 8, will show marked improvement in its seed corn operations over 1996," Wittenburg said in a report.
-- She estimates third quarter earnings at a profit of $0.42 a share, up from a profit of $0.11 a year ago.

-- She added that she expects Dow Elanco to go up to its agreed upon limit of owning 60 percent of Mycogen's shares by February 1998, and could end up owning all of Mycogen within the next 12 to 18 months.
